notes.title: 0.8.0 Patch Update
notes.notes: [p][/p][h1][b]🚀 Pixel Starships 2 – Patch 0.8.0[/b][/h1][p][/p][p][/p][p]Captains, we’re rolling out one of our biggest stability-focused updates yet![/p][p]This patch squashes bugs, boosts performance, and sets the stage for our upcoming September feature updates.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]⚡ Major Improvements[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Massive Stability Update[/b] – Core systems reworked to reduce crashes and desyncs.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved Network & Matchmaking[/b] – Faster, fairer PvP battles and smoother fleet operations.[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI/UX Enhancements[/b] – Cleaner menus, streamlined layouts, and more responsive controls.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]🛠️ Fixes & Optimizations[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Fixed [b]in-app purchase reliability[/b] issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved [b]storyline progression bugs[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Updated and expanded the[b] Wiki[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]system travel issues[/b] and edge-case errors.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved [b]VIP reward functionality[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]rearm bugs[/b] affecting weapon reloads.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved [b]league display glitches[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]drone deployment issues[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected [b]shipyard and fleet management bugs[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed [b]layout-related issues[/b] causing crashes.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized [b]network stability[/b] for smoother multiplayer.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]🔮 What’s Next[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][/p][p]Over the next 3 weeks, we’ll be rolling out the [b]September Feature Update[/b], packed with new gameplay content, competitive systems, and more surprises. Stay tuned![/p]
